decisions.why: Neocate Junior, LCP, Syneo and Spoon are amino-acid-based infant formula products for cow's-milk-allergic infants -- same brand family Nutricia Ltd's own record already maps to neonatal:milk for the identical reason (both records read the same domain, nutricia.co.uk).
Aptamil Pepti 1, Pepti 2 and Pepti Syneo are all explicitly named "Formula" -- extensively hydrolysed infant formula for cow's-milk allergy, the same infant-formula shape as the Neocate range above.
